rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("Collects") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The citing entity describes work that uses data presented in the cited entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has given name
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This property expresses the personal or first name of an agent involved with the resource (e.g., creator, contributor, etc.). The agent must be a `foaf:Person`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The given name of some person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is compiled by
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsCompiledBy") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The cited entity is the result of a compile or creation event using the citing entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has edition
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express the edition number or string of a resource.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier for one of several alternate issues of a magazine or other resource.
rdf:Description.skos:note: An issue of a magazine may be produced in multiple editions, with each edition providing content customized for a particular demographic or geographic group. Fortune, for example, is produced in a Domestic edition, a European edition, and an Asian edition. While much of the content overlaps, there is some content that is unique to each edition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conference proceedings
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Conference Proceeding").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A document containing the programme and collected conference papers, or their abstracts, presented at a conference, seminar, symposium or similar event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organization identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify an organization.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
This is used to specify the identifier scheme used by an organization identifier.
Individual schemes are defined as members of this class.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: url
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Uniform Resource Locator (URL) is a unique identifier for a resource retrievable on the World Wide Web.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has location
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-dataset-location frapo:hasLocation "The common area between Tuscany and Liguria" .
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to provide a textual description for the location under consideration.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relevant location, which might be geographical (e.g. _New York City_) or local (e.g. _Freezer B, second shelf_).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is cited for information by
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsReferencedBy") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The cited entity is cited as a source of information on the subject under discussion in the citing entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has creator list
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to associate an ordered author list to a resource. The list is modelled as an instance of the class `co:List`, which permits the specification of an ordered sequence of elements (in this case, a series of authors) via the usage of properties such as `co:firstItem`, `co:item` and `co:lastItem`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The list of the creators of a certain resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is cited by
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsCitedBy") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The cited entity (the subject of the RDF triple) is cited by the citing entity (the object of the triple).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has publication year
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express the year a resource was published or issued in.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The year of publication of a work.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A sub-property of the generic `dcterms:issued` that accepts values with the `xsd:gYear` datatype.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: book
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Book").
This is also used in combination with `fabio:hasSequenceIdentifier` to specify the sequence identifier/number type.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A non-serial document that is complete in one volume or a designated finite number of volumes. A book published by a publisher is usually identified by an International Standard Book Number (ISBN), and may be manifested as a physical printed publication on paper bound in a hard or soft cover, or in electronic format as an "e-book".

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: preprint
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Preprint").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The version of an author's original scholarly work, such as a research paper or a review, first submitted to publisher for publication.
rdf:Description.skos:note: For that version resubmitted after peer-review and revision, use `fabio:Postprint`. For the final published version use `fabio:DefinitiveVersion`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An entity (e.g., a person) connected to a particular value-in-time situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Digital Object Identifier (DOI) is a unique identifier assigned to identify digital objects.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A DOI is resolvable from the following URL: http://www.doi.org/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is cited as data source by
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsSourceOf") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The cited entity is cited as a data source by the citing entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: host institution
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Hosting Institution").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by a institution of hosting some initiative, people, or event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has geometry
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to link a spatial entity to its geolocation point, which can be expressed in terms of longitude and latitude.
The point (i.e., an individual of the class `sf:Point`) defining the location of the resource under consideration. The actual value of the point can be defined by means of the property geo:asWKT, which allows the specification of the coordinates of the point.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A spatial representation for a given feature.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Model").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A mathematical, graphical or physical representation of some physical reality, conceptual idea or theoretical construct.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dblp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The DBLP author identifier is a unique key assigned to each researcher registered on DBLP.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A DBLP author identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://dblp.org/pid/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pii
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Publisher Item Identifier is a unique identifier used by several scientific journal publishers to identify documents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: w3id
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The W3id.org identifier is a secure, permanent URL re-direction service for Web applications, run by the W3C Permanent Identifier Community Group.
rdf:Description.skos:note: It has the shape of a URL starting with "https://w3id.org/" plus a local identifier that completes it (e.g. "https://w3id.org/changes").

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has ending page
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express the last page of a resource.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The last page number for the published version of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) is an eight-digit code to uniquely identify a periodical publication, such as a magazine.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pmid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The PubMed Identifier (PMID) is a bibliographic identifier for the PubMed database.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: Someone's affiliation is a relationship of membership or belonging that the person can have with respect to a particular organization (i.e., an individual of the class `foaf:Organization`). Such an affiliation may be specified in the document with respect to which that agent is an author or contributor. A particular individual of [SCoRO](http://purl.org/spar/scoro), i.e., `scoro:affiliate` (belonging to the class `scoro:OrganizationalRole`) is used to express such an affiliation. The domain of `pro:withRole` is not `foaf:Agent`, but rather a member of the class `pro:RoleInTime`, which itself is the range of the property `pro:holdsRoleInTime`, for which the domain is `foaf:Agent` (i.e., our contributor).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An entity representing the context for a time-indexed situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lsid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Life Science Identifier (LSID) is a unique identifier used for uniquely naming significant resources in the biology domain.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cites as metadata document
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("HasMetadata") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The citing entity cites the cited entity as being the container of metadata describing the citing entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: feature
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A discrete spatial phenomenon in a universe of discourse.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: article
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The realization of a piece of writing on a particular topic, usually published within a periodical publication (e.g. journal, magazine and newspaper).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is realization of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A work realized throgh an expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: oclc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The OCLC control number is a unique identifier assigned by OCLC to each bibliographic record input into WorldCat.
rdf:Description.skos:note: An OCLC control number is resolvable from the following URL: https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is relation object of
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the qualified relation (modelled via the class `datacite:QualifiedRelation`) between two resources aving one of these as its object.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation in its reified form linked to a resource that is the object in such a relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: action
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to model the fact that a related source is an instrument. More specifically, an instance of `schema:Action` is used, connected to a `frbr:Endeavour` via the property `schema:instrument`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An action performed by a direct agent and indirect participants upon a direct object. Optionally happens at a location with the help of an inanimate instrument. The execution of the action may produce a result. Specific action sub-type documentation specifies the exact expectation of each argument/role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: geometry
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A coherent set of direct positions in space.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: replaces
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("Obsoletes") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Text").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A resource consisting primarily of words for reading.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples include books, letters, dissertations, poems, newspapers, articles, archives of mailing lists. Note that facsimiles or images of texts are still of the genre Text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: repec
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The RePEc Short identifier is a unique, permanent identifier for researchers registered in the RePEc Author Service.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A RePEc Short Identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://authors.repec.org/pro/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resource paper
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Data Paper").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A scholarly work that describes resources developed to provide experimental materials or facilities, support a research hypothesis, to provide answers to a research question, or that have contributed to the generation of novel scientific work.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples of such resources include, for experimental sciences, mouse mutant lines and large communally used X-ray or neutron sources, and, for computer sciences, datasets, ontologies, vocabularies, ontology design patterns, evaluation benchmarks or methods, services, APIs and software frameworks, workflows, crowdsourcing task designs, protocols and metrics.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has format
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This should be used if the type of the relation between two resources refers to the association of metadata by one to the other. This allows to declare the particular format in which the metadata in the metadata document are stored. The format should be defined as an individual of the class `dcterms:MediaTypeOrExtent`.
Instead of creating a new media type every time, it is strongly suggested to reuse those already available in existing datasets, such as the “Media type as Linked Open Data” dataset (https://w3id.org/spar/mediatype).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review version
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Peer Review").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A version of a given review, defining its content and rating, which may vary over the time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: social security number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The United States of America social security number is a nine-digit number issued to U.S. residents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project plan
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Project").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A document used to guide project planning, execution and control, specifying the project's goal and objectives and the activities and resources required to achieve these, setting out the project schedule, and identifying the major workpackages, milestones and deliverables. A project plan will typically contain a Gantt chart.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contact person
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Contact Person").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who serves as the primary contact and information provider for third parties wishing to find out more about an organization or an activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: image
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A visual representation other than text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: moving image
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Audiovisual").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A series of visual representations imparting an impression of motion when shown in succession.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples include animations, movies, television programs, videos, zoetropes, or visual output from a simulation. Instances of the type Moving Image must also be describable as instances of the broader type Image.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("Describes") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The citing entity describes the cited entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: within context
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specific context within which the fact of the entity having the value is relevant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: local personal identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A personal identifier scheme that provides local personal identifiers that are unique in their local environment and understood by the person submitting the metadata.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualified relation
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to represent qualified relations between two resources, which can be described using various properties (e.g., `dcterms:description`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A class representing a reified relation between two resources, allowing the assignment of a specific role or type to the relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has volume
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express the volume number of a resource.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Additional identifier for the publication where the resource appeared, providing the Volume portion of the common Volume, Number scheme.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Provided for basic bibliographic citations. The content should not contain “Vol.” or other abbreviations for “Volume”; it should only be the alphanumeric volume identifier. The Number portion of the issue identification is specified in the prism:number element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ror
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Research Organization Registry (ROR) Community identifier is a unique code assigned to research organizations.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A ROR identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://ror.org/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Service").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A system that provides one or more functions.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples include a photocopying service, a banking service, an authentication service, interlibrary loans, a Z39.50 or Web server.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is role held by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The agent holding a role in time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organization identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent identifiers associated with organizations, modelled as instances of `foaf:Organization`.
An organization identifier belongs to a particular identifier scheme, such as ISNI, specified by an individual within the class `datacite:OrganizationIdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identities an individual organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration authority
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Registration Authority").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of an agent with responsibility for registering and maintaining international standards, internet domain names, patents, controlled vocabularies and other similar entities required for reliable international cooperatative activities. For example, the International DOI Foundation (IDF) is the Registration Authority for DOIs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nihmsid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The NIH Manuscript Submission Identifier (NIHMSID) is a preliminary article identifier that applies only to manuscripts deposited through the NIHMS system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has subject
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This property should always be used with a [SKOS](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#) concept. If possible, one could specify a more specific property rather than the general `dcterms:subject`, such as `fabio:hasSubjectTerm` and `fabio:hasSubjectDiscipline`. Instead of creating a new concept every time, one could reuse concepts already available in existing SKOS-based models.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A topic of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: zbmath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The zbMATH author identifier is a unique identifier used for a person in the Zentralblatt MATH database.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A zbMATH author identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is required by
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsRequiredBy") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: concept
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to represent subjects.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An idea or notion; a unit of thought.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: provides data for
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsCollectedBy") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The cited entity presents data that are used in work described in the citing entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: workpackage leader
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Workpackage Leader").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person or institution has of being leader for a workpackage or sub-project within a project such as a research project, with responsibility for ensuring that the proposed work is undertaken and documented, the generated data are properly curated and archived, and the results are published and reported to the funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has supplement
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsSupplementedBy") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An expression work/expression having another one as supplement.
rdf:Description.skos:note: The supplement relationship type involves works/expressions that are intended to be used in conjunction with another work/expression. Some of these, such as indices, concordances, teachers' guides, glosses, and instruction manuals for electronic resources will be so closely associated with the content of the related work/expression that they are useless without the other work/expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has URL
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the URL of a certain resource, including subject terms, subject schemes, identifier schemes, and so on.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier, in form of an HTTP Universal Resource Locator (URL), for a particular resource on the World Wide Web.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research gate
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The ResearchGate profile identifier is a unique code for researchers registered in the ResearchGate platform.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A ResearchGate profile identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is revision of
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsNewVersionOf") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: It identifies the previous expression of a revised one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metadata scheme
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-resource cito:citesAsMetadataDocument :my-resource-metadata .
:my-resource-metadata a fabio:MetadataDocument ; datacite:hasMetadataScheme datacite:spar .
datacite:spar a datacite:MetadataScheme .
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent the particular scheme followed for creating the resource metadata exemplified in the metadata document, via the property `datacite:hasMetadataScheme` and the class `datacite:MetadataScheme`.
This is also used when the relation type between two resources involves the association of metadata to one by the other. It is possible to specify a metadata scheme used by the particular metadata document under consideration to describe the metadata of the subject resource or of the related resource. In addition to specifying a metadata scheme, in this case the metadata document can also be characterised by means of the class `fabio:MetatadaDocument`. Each metadata scheme is an individual of the class `datacite:MetadataScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The class that describe metadata schemes used for creating a metadata document referring to a certain resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has relation subject
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the subject of a qualified relation (modelled via the class `datacite:QualifiedRelation`) between two resources.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The resource that is the subject of a reified relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role in time
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: According to this class, someone's affiliation is a relationship of membership or belonging that the person can have with respect to a particular organization (i.e., an individual of the class `foaf:Organization`). Such an affiliation may be specified in the document with respect to which that agent is an author or contributor. A particular individual of [SCoRO](http://purl.org/spar/scoro), i.e., `scoro:affiliate` (belonging to the class `scoro:OrganizationalRole`) is used to express such an affiliation. The domain of `pro:withRole` is not `foaf:Agent`, but rather a member of the class `pro:RoleInTime`, which itself is the range of the property `pro:holdsRoleInTime`, for which the domain is `foaf:Agent` (i.e., our contributor).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A particular situation that describe a role an agent may have, that can be restricted to a particular time interval.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: primary resource identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent primary identifiers associated with resources.
This class uses a `datacite:IdentifierScheme` that is restricted to `datacite:doi`, an individual in the `datacite:ResourceIdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that is used as the primary identifier to uniquely identifies the primary resource that is the subject of the DataCite metadata record.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: collection
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Collection").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An aggregation of resources.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A collection is described as a group; its parts may also be separately described.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has translation
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("HasTranslation") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An expression translated in another one.
rdf:Description.skos:note: It allows to refer to a literal translation, in which the intent is to render the intellectual content of the previous expression as accurately as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: abstract
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to represent the description type "Abstract".
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A brief summary of a textual work, appearing at the beginning of the work and designed to act as the point-of-entry that will help the reader quickly to obtain an overview of the work's contents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: workflow
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Workflow").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A recorded sequence of connected steps, which may be automated, specifying a reliably repeatable sequence of operations to be undertaken when conducting a particular job, for example an in silico investigation that extracts and processes information from a number of bioinformatics databases.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funder
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: A funding agent is represented as an instance of `foaf:Agent`, related to the resource through the pattern defined in the Publishing Roles Ontology (PRO). According to said pattern, a `foaf:Agent` holds some role (`pro:RoleInTime`) characterized by a type (`pro:withRole`) - which, in this case, is `scoro:funder` - and related to the resource via `pro:relatesToEntity`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role held by an agent of providing funds, for example for a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: identifier scheme
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-resource datacite:hasIdentifier :my-resource-id .
:my-resource-id datacite:usesIdentifierScheme datacite:wikidata ; literal:hasLiteralValue "Q113333457" .
datacite:wikidata a datacite:IdentifierScheme .
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to specify the identifier scheme used by an identifier.
Individual schemes are defined as members of this class.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify an entity such as a funding agency, a person or a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sound
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Sound").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A resource primarily intended to be heard.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples include a C source file, MS-Windows .exe executable, or Perl script.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: literal
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: A reified literal can be used to express cases such as a date that can have a description attached to it. It is linked to the resource via the property `literal:hasLiteral`. The value is contained in the reified literal and is expressed through the data property `literal:hasLiteralValue`. Other information, such as the type of value (e.g., the date type), is expressed via the punning mechanism that allows one to use properties as individuals, and linked to the reified literal with an appropriate property (e.g., `dcterms:type`, `dcterms:dateAccepted`, `fabio:hasDateCollected`, etc.).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reified literal.
rdf:Description.skos:note: The literal value it represents is specified through the property `literal:hasLiteralValue`. Each individual of this class must always have a specified value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uri
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) is a unique identifier for abstract or physical resources.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
The physical embodiment of an expression of a work.
The entity defined as manifestation encompasses a wide range of materials and formats. As an entity, manifestation represents all the physical objects that bear the same characteristics, in respect to both intellectual content and physical form.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: distributor
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Distributor").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who distributes or disseminates publications or other resources.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: github
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The GitHub username is a unique identifier assigned to GitHub users.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A GitHub username is resolvable from the following URL: https://github.com/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: OpenAlex ID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The OpenAlex ID is a unique identifier assigned to each entity included in OpenAlex.
rdf:Description.skos:note: An OpenAlex ID has two parts. The first part is the base, that is always https://openalex.org/. The second part is the key, i.e. the unique primary key that identifies a given resource in our database. The key starts with a letter that tells us the kind of entity: W(ork), A(uthor), V(enue), I(nstitution), or C(oncept). In addition, the IDs are not case-sensitive, so w2741809807 is just as valid as W2741809807.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is arrangement of
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("IsVariantFormOf") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The original expression of an arranged one.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: organizational role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to an organization and its administration, particularly within an academic context. Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dataset
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Dataset").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data encoded in a defined structure.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples include lists, tables, and databases. A dataset may be useful for direct machine processing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data manager
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Data Manager").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being a data manager, responsible for day-to-day management, maintenance and back-up of data, for example those arising from the research project or held in a repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has date valid
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used as a controlled term to specify a given date type ("Valid").
This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a date (modelled as an instance of `literal:Literal`) via the property `dcterms:type`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Date of validity of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: as WKT
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express actual value of a point by specifying its coordinates in `geo:wktLiteral` format.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The WKT serialization of a geometry.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: event
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Event").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A non-persistent, time-based occurrence.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Metadata for an event provides descriptive information that is the basis for discovery of the purpose, location, duration, and responsible agents associated with an event. Examples include an exhibition, webcast, conference, workshop, open day, performance, battle, trial, wedding, tea party, conflagration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: upc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Universal Product Code (UPC) is a unique number used to identify products and their manufacturers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: financial role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to academic and project finance. Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: alternate resource identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent alternate identifiers associated with resources.
An alternate resource identifier belongs to a particular scheme, such as ISBN, specified by an individual that is a member of the class `datacite:ResourceIdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier other than a DOI that is used as an alternative identifier to uniquely identify a resource that is the subject of the DataCite metadata record.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has part
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("HasPart") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uses metadata scheme
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent the particular scheme followed for creating the resource metadata exemplified in the metadata document, via the property `datacite:hasMetadataScheme` and the class `datacite:MetadataScheme`.
This is also used when the relation type between two resources involves the association of metadata to one by the other. It is possible to specify a metadata scheme used by the particular metadata document under consideration to describe the metadata of the subject resource or of the related resource. In addition to specifying a metadata scheme, in this case the metadata document can also be characterised by means of the class `fabio:MetatadaDocument`. Each metadata scheme is an individual of the class `datacite:MetadataScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The link between a metadata document and the scheme followed for creating metadata.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has sequence identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to express the year a resource was published or issued in.
The type of number identifier can be expressed by specifying the class of the resource: for example, whether the related resource is a "Book" (`fabio:Book`), a "Chapter" (`fabio:Chapter`), a "Report" (`fabio:ReportDocument`) or "Other" (`frbr:Endeavour`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A literal (for example a number or a letter) that identifies the sequence position of a work within a particular context, for example a book in a book series, a chapter in a document, a volume in a journal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bibcode
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Bibliographic Code (BIBCODE) is a 19 ASCII characters identifier which describes a journal article.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chapter
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Chapter").
This is also used in combination with `fabio:hasSequenceIdentifier` to specify the sequence identifier/number type.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A defined document section, forming part of or intended for inclusion within a larger document, usually with its own title or chapter number. Different chapters within a document such as a book or a report may each be independently authored, or may all be authored by a single individual or group of authors.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: with value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value had by the entity taking part to the situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A subclass of FRBR Work, restricted to works that are published or potentially publishable, and that contain or are referred to by bibliographic references, or entities used to define bibliographic references.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has relation object
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the object of a qualified relation (modelled via the class `datacite:QualifiedRelation`) between two resources.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The resource that is the object of a reified relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expression
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
The intellectual or artistic realization of a work in the form of alpha-numeric, musical, or choreographic notation, sound, image, object, movement, etc., or any combination of such forms.
An expression is the specific intellectual or artistic form that a work takes each time it is "realized". Expression encompasses, for example, the specific words, sentences, paragraphs, etc. that result from the realization of a work in the form of a text, or the particular sounds, phrasing, etc. resulting from the realization of a musical work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Open Researcher and Contributor Identifier (ORCID) is a unique identifier for individuals to use as they engage in research, scholarship, and innovation activities.
rdf:Description.skos:note: An ORCID is resolvable from the following URL: http://orcid.org/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has retraction date
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used as a controlled term to specify a given date type ("Withdrawn").
This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a date (modelled as an instance of `literal:Literal`) via the property `dcterms:type`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date on which something, for example a claim or a journal article, is retracted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: spatial object
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Anything spatial (being or having a shape, position or an extent).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify a polygon (i.e., an individual of the class `sf:Polygon`) defining the geographical box related to the resource under consideration. The actual value of the polygon can be defined by means of the property `geo:asWKT`, which allows the specification of the coordinates related with the polygon.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thing spatially contains another thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has longitude
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express the WGS84 longitude of a geographical feature in decimal degrees.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The WGS84 longitude of a thing, expressed in decimal degrees.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to represent the description type "Other".
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A catch-all description type required by the DataCite Metadata Schema to characterize description types that are not abstracts, series information or tables of content.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: igsn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The International Generic Sample Number (IGSN) is a code that uniquely identifies samples from our natural environment and related features-of-interest.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent identifiers in the most generic conceptualization possible.
An identifier belongs to a particular scheme, such as those specified by individuals of the class `datacite:IdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identities an entity, such as a funding agency, a person or a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has preferred label
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the label of a subject (modelled as an instance of `skos:Concept`) or a subject scheme (`skos:ConceptScheme`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The preferred lexical label for a resource, in a given language.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A resource has no more than one value of `skos:prefLabel` per language tag, and no more than one value of `skos:prefLabel` without language tag.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: infouri
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Info URI scheme is a standardized method for identifying information assets that have public identifiers (like ISBNs, DOIs, or LCCNs) but lack a native URI representation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resource identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent identifiers associated with resources.
An alternate resource identifier belongs to a particular scheme, such as ISBN, specified by an individual that is a member of the class `datacite:ResourceIdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that is used to uniquely identify a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to a project. Individual members of this class are used to specify particular roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resource identifier scheme
rdf:Description.vann:example:
:my-resource datacite:hasIdentifier :my-resource-id .
:my-resource-id a datacite:ResourceIdentifier ; datacite:usesIdentifierScheme datacite:doi .
datacite:doi a datacite:ResourceIdentifierScheme .
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to specify the identifier scheme used by a resource identifier.
Individual schemes are defines as members of this class. For DataCite, the only permitted identifier scheme for the primary resource identifier is the Digital Object Identifier (`datacite:doi`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: wikipedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Wikipedia page name is a unique identifier used to refer to any entity present in a Wikipedia database.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A Wikipedia page name is resolvable from the following URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has family name
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This property expresses the surname or last name of an agent involved with the resource (e.g., creator, contributor, etc.). The agent must be a `foaf:Person`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The family name of some person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: awards
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to specify the grant or award number associated with the funding awarded by some funder agent. More specifically, a `foaf:Agent` awards (`frapo:awards`) a grant (`frapo:Grant`) with a certain number associated to it (`frapo:hasGrantNumber`).
This property is also used to express the fact that a related resource is an award. More specifically, this is modelled using an instance of `frbr:Endeavour` and a `foaf:Agent` connected to it via the property `frapo:awards`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Something an agent awards, for example a grant awarded by a funding agency, a degree by a university, or a prize by an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has description
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-dataset-date-created dcterms:description "The creation date might be subject to change."@en .
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to associate additional information to a date (modelled as an instance of `literal:Literal`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An account of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uses identifier scheme
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the scheme followed by a certain identifier. Its value should be a named individual belonging to either `datacite:ResourceIdentifierScheme`, `datacite:AgentIdentifierScheme` (or its sub-classes) or `datacite:RightsIdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to provide the identifier for an entity (either a funder, a person, a license or a resource).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: report
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Study Registration").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal factual, methodological, statistical, technical or research report issued by an individual, group, agency, government body or other institution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: project manager
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Project Manager").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role a person has of being project manager for a project such as a research project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: national insurance number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The United Kingdom National Insurance Number is a code used to uniquely identify in the tax system, banking, social welfare, online government services and electoral registration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: grant
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the grant or award number associated with the funding awarded by some funder agent. More specifically, a foaf:Agent awards (`frapo:awards`) a grant (`frapo:Grant`) with a certain number associated to it (`frapo:hasGrantNumber`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A financial award by a funding agency for a particular project or purpose, usually awarded on the basis of a competitive application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: linkedin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The LinkedIn personal profile identifier is an unique identifier assigned to a LinkedIn user.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A LinkedIn personal profile identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://www.linkedin.com/in/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: description type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The type of description given to a resource described by the DataCite Metadata schema.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data management plan
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Output Management Plan").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A structured document giving information about how data arising from a research project or other endeavour is to be manages, preserved and shared.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gnd
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Gemeinsame Normdatei (GND) identifier is a unique key assigned to authority data managed by the German National Library.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A Gemeinsame Normdatei identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://d-nb.info/gnd/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funder identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent identifiers associated with funding agencies, modelled as instances of `foaf:Organization`.
A funder identifier belongs to a particular scheme, such as FundRef, specified by an individual within the class `datacite:FunderIdentifierScheme`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identities a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent identifier
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent identifiers associated with agents, generally modelled as instances of `foaf:Agent` or its sub-classes (`foaf:Person` and `foaf:Organization`).
An agent identifier belongs to a particular identifier scheme, specified by an individual within the class `datacite:AgentIdentifierScheme` (or any of its subclasses).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identities an individual agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has coverage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, spatial applicability of the resource, or jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An explicit description of, or set of requirements to be satisfied by, a material, product, resource, service or standard.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: book chapter
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Book Chapter").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific chapter focused on engineering methodologies within a scholarly handbook.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: google scholar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Google Scholar author identifier is a unique identifier assigned to authors signed to Google Scholar.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A Google Scholar author identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has related endeavour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Another endeavour that is related in some way to an endeavour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supervisor
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Supervisor").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who guides and oversees the research activities of a team member, or who formally supervises a student during that student's research project undertaken as part of a degree course at a university.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: jst
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Japanese Science and Technology Agency (JST) identifier is a unique code assigned to scientific research products by the Japan Science and Technology Agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expression
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: The use of `fabio:Expression` and its sub-classes allows the association of a particular resource with a resource type. While not mandatory, the use of [FaBiO](http://purl.org/spar/fabio) entities is strongly recommended. If there is no specific [FaBiO](http://purl.org/spar/fabio) Expression class that matches the resource under consideration, use of the most abstract class, i.e., `fabio:Expression`, is suggested.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A subclass of [FRBR](http://purl.org/spar/frbr) Expression, restricted to expressions of `fabio:Work`.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
For your latest research paper, the preprint submitted to the publisher, and the final published version to which the publisher assigned a unique digital object identifier, are both expressions of the same work.
A `fabio:Expression` can only have part or be part of another `fabio:Expression`. Moreover, it can be a representation only of a `fabio:Work`, and it can be embodied only in instances of `fabio:Manifestation`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: spatial thing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Anything with spatial extent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reviews
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("Reviews") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The citing entity reviews statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dblp record
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The DBLP publication identifier is a unique key that identifies a specific publication record, conference, or journal registered on DBLP.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A DBLP publication identifier is resolvable from the following URL: https://dblp.org/rec/<identifier>.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: group
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A group of agents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used to represent agents.
For example, an agent related to some resource can be specified by means of the class `foaf:Agent`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: still image
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Image").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A static visual representation.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Examples include paintings, drawings, graphic designs, plans and maps. Recommended best practice is to assign the type Text to images of textual materials. Instances of the type Still Image must also be describable as instances of the broader type Image.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relation
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("Other") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A related resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A subclass of FRBR Manifestation, restricted to manifestations of fabio:Expression. fabio:Manifestation specifically applies to electronic (digital) as well as to physical manifestations of expressions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: editor
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given agent role type ("Editor").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The role of a person who selects and prepares for publication material created and submitted by authors, having oversight of its content, format and presentation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fundref
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The FundRef identifier is a unique code assigned by Fundref, a collaborative pilot project of scholarly publishers and funding agencies, facilitated by CrossRef, to provide a standard way of identifying and reporting funding sources for published scholarly research.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manuscript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A textual work prepared "by hand", such as a typescript or word-processed pre-publication draft of a research paper or a report, or a work not otherwise reproduced in multiple copies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conference paper
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used as a controlled term to specify a given general resource type ("Conference Paper").
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A paper, typically the realization of a research paper reporting original research findings, usually published within a conference proceedings volume.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rrid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Research Resource IDentifier (RRID) is a character string used to uniquely identify key inputs to an experiment including the so-called “key biological resources” as defined by the National Institutes of Health, and related tools such as core facilities and databases.
rdf:Description.skos:note: An RRID name is divided into two parts, the authority and a local identifier, separated by an underscore.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to organization
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: Someone's affiliation is a relationship of membership or belonging that the person can have with respect to a particular organization (i.e., an individual of the class `foaf:Organization`). Such an affiliation may be specified in the document with respect to which that agent is an author or contributor. A particular individual of [SCoRO](http://purl.org/spar/scoro), i.e., `scoro:affiliate` (belonging to the class `scoro:OrganizationalRole`) is used to express such an affiliation. The domain of `pro:withRole` is not `foaf:Agent`, but rather a member of the class `pro:RoleInTime`, which itself is the range of the property `pro:holdsRoleInTime`, for which the domain is `foaf:Agent` (i.e., our contributor).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization representing the context for a time-indexed situation (e.g. relating the role of member to the institution of which that person is a member).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notebook
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A book containing personal notes, typically created by writing into a physical book with blank pages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
A distinct intellectual or artistic creation.
A work is an abstract entity; there is no single material object one can point to as the work. We recognize the work through individual realizations or expressions of the work, but the work itself exists only in the commonality of content between and among the various expressions of the work. When we speak of Homer's Iliad as a work, our point of reference is not a particular recitation or text of the work, but the intellectual creation that lies behind all the various expressions of the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: educational role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role that an agent might hold with respect to an educational organization or activity. Individual members of this class are used to specify particular educational roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rights identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identifies a license.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
This is used to represent identifiers associated with rights.
A rights identifier belongs to a particular scheme, such as SPDX, specified by an individual within the class `datacite:RightsIdentifierScheme`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has temporal coverage
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale:
This is used as a controlled term to specify a given date type ("Coverage").
This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/WD-owl2-new-features-20090611/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a date (modelled as an instance of `literal:Literal`) via the property `dcterms:type`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has extent
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify a possible extent for the resource under consideration, defined as an individual of the class `dcterms:SizeOrDuration`. When possible, such an individual can be accompanied by more specific data properties depending on the actual extent we are considering (e.g. `rdf:value`, `prism:pageRange`, `fabio:hasPageCount`, etc.).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The size or duration of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: value in time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A time-indexed situation that represents a hub linking the entity having a particular value, the value itself and the temporal and contextual extents from which the entity-value relationship depends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: local organization identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization identifier scheme that provides local organization identifiers that are unique in their local environment and understood by the person submitting the metadata.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An amount of money available to finance some project or activity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has grant number
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to specify the grant or award number associated with the funding awarded by some funder agent. More specifically, a `foaf:Agent` awards (`frapo:awards`) a grant (`frapo:Grant`) with a certain number associated to it (`frapo:hasGrantNumber`).
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A data property specifying the grant number of a grant provided by a funding agency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A view on a set of entities. It can be seen as a "relational context", reifying a relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has starting page
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used to express the first page of a resource.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The first page number for the published version of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Persistent Uniform Resource Locator (PURL) is a URL that is used to redirect to the location of a requested web resource.
